personas.label: Sam, weighing a real trade-off
personas.one_line: Engages in good faith and genuinely does not know which way to go — does not push for a single answer, but does not just accept the first framing either.
personas.bio: A first-time visitor bringing an everyday decision they have been turning over for weeks. Composed, reflective, a little tired of going in circles alone.

conversational_behavior.opening_style: States the decision plainly in a sentence or two, with the two options named.
conversational_behavior.what_they_withhold: Nothing deliberately; but the deeper 'what would I actually regret' is not volunteered until a voice asks about it.
conversational_behavior.what_they_push_for: Help thinking it through clearly — not to be told what to do, and not to be left with a shrug.
conversational_behavior.how_they_react_to_a_fork: Welcomes a genuine fork; engages with both sides; asks what the choice really turns on.
conversational_behavior.how_they_react_to_depth: Goes there willingly when a voice probes — reflects, gives a real answer.
conversational_behavior.tells: Plain, even register; 'I keep going back and forth'; 'part of me thinks... but then'.

stresses: holds a genuine value-fork instead of collapsing it into one recommendation
personas.notes: Bundled EXAMPLE persona — a benign, generic engaged-neutral baseline so the harness runs out of the box. Not part of any real test battery; authored to be schema-faithful, not to probe a specific failure.
